_about: Nounda brand tokens, the one source for every asset generator (site redesign of 2026-10, approved assets of 2026-10-28). Edit here, then run `node run/sync-brand.mjs` to copy into each repo. Social cards keep their colour photography and topic accents by decision (see socialCards).

field.about: Light grey grained wash, ink type (thumbnails, list panels, light slides)

glass.about: Dark frosted card, cream type (chapter cards, labels over footage, callouts)

glow.about: The highlight: white lit from behind. Chip = ink type on white with a three-layer halo; text = glowing white type.
